savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14049 in full (secs. 1-6): sec. 4(b) revoked EO 13592 (Improving American Indian and Alaska Native Educational Opportunities and Strengthening Tribal Colleges and Universities), effective on signing 2021-10-11, and provided that this order supersedes conflicting or overlapping orders on these subjects. EO 14148 sec. 2(nn) revokes EO 14049 without revival wording, and revoking a revoking order does not by itself revive the order it revoked, so EO 13592 stays revoked: an effect of EO 14049 survives it (accrued). The Initiative (sec. 2) is an office in the Department of Education that ends with the order; the National Advisory Council on Indian Education and its duties exist by statute (ESEA sec. 6141, 20 U.S.C. 7471) independently of the order, and sec. 2(f)/3(d) funding is 'to the extent permitted by law and subject to appropriations'. No function, fund or property was transferred and sec. 6(c) disclaims private rights. research_rationale: EO 14049 (signed 2021-10-11, 86 FR 57313-57318), read in full from the held official FR text, establishes the White House Initiative in the Department of Education (sec. 2), makes the National Advisory Council on Indian Education its advisory council (sec. 3), sets administrative provisions and revokes EO 13592 (sec. 4), defines terms (sec. 5) and has general provisions (sec. 6). It has no term or sunset: the only timing words are the 180-day deadline for Memoranda of Agreement (sec. 2(d)) and the annual report 'no later than 1 year after the date of this order and annually thereafter' (sec. 2(i)); neither is an end, and no clause needs a report date to find its end. EO 14148 sec. 2(nn) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes the order with no effective-date wording, effective on signing 2025-01-20. Dossier missing lines read: EO 13647 (held official text) does not name EO 14049, and its OFR cross-reference is EO 14049's own reference to the White House Council on Native American Affairs it created, so it is ruled out; EO 14091 (sec. 2(b)(iii), read) only lists EO 14049 among Initiatives the Steering Committee coordinates with and EO 14081 (sec. 13(l), read) only borrows EO 14049's definition of Tribal Colleges and Universities, so neither amends, extends or ends any provision, and both are ruled out as later events. The dossier's 54 clauses run contiguously from sec. 1 to the signature line (the 'dup' suffixes are repeated (i) labels, not repeated text) so the inventory is kept as is. No other held official text names EO 14049 (EO 9285, 9286 and 9289 hold the number only as a page reference). Savings: completed revocation accrues (see savings reason).
